meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides app pop-ups, Reels, Explore, Stories, suggestions, counts, Messages; blurs or hides grid pictures, post media, avatars
meta.notes:
**2026-11-13 additions** (iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chrome, logged out, /nasa/ and a /p/ page): `thumbnails`, `post-media` and `avatars` are choice options (Show, Blur, Hide); the first choice is the untouched state.
- **LIVE**: `hr ~ div a img` matched 12 grid pictures on /nasa/ (13 `a[href*=applink.instagram.com] img` in all, one is not a tile); `header section img` 1 and `header section canvas` 1 (avatar and story ring); `header section a[href="#"]` 2 (the logged-out follower and following links, text `104M followers`, `91 following`); `a[href^="/u/direct"]` 1 on the logged-out bottom bar (the layout there uses `/u/direct/` and `/u/profile/`).
- **SOURCE/INFERRED, logged-in only**: `main a[href*="/p/"] img` and `/reel/` grid links, `article img[srcset]` and `article video` for post media, `article header img`, `a[href$="/followers/"]` and `/following/`, `a[href*="/liked_by/"]` (long-standing like-count link), and the `/direct/` entry layouts. Fixture `logged-in-profile.html` is hand-written. Blur style follows shraiwi Nuke Insta Slop (2026-03), which blurs and dims suggested and video posts.
- Not verified: any logged-in page; whether `article img[srcset]` separates photos from avatars on today's feed (avatars would otherwise also hit the avatars option); Instagram help pages describe a native Hide like and share counts setting, which is the safer way to hide counts on your own account.

**Earlier checks**

LIVE (logged out, iPhone UA, 390x844): app-overlay matched 1 element (the fixed overlay holding the dialog, backdrop and close button; hiding the dialog alone leaves the dimmed backdrop), open-app-pill matched 1 (unscoped a[href*=applink.instagram.com] matches 18, every grid tile), the Reels and Explore tab wrappers matched 1 each. The overlay rule needs a login link on the page, so a logged-in share sheet (also role=dialog) is never hidden. Not seen live (logged-in only, from community lists: viki53 Instagram Purified 2025-07, shraiwi Nuke Insta Slop 2026-09, Instagram Unhook): reels-video-posts, stories-tray, suggested-*, posts, wrapped tab layout. reels-profile-tab: the SVG label was seen live, the wrapper structure was not. reels-video-posts also hides ordinary video posts. posts also hides a post opened by address. Class names rotate; never use them. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA, logged out, live in the app, 2026-11-10): the login page is all a logged-out visitor gets on /; public profiles such as /nasa/ render. Matched there: profile-highlights, verified-ticks, page-footer. The feed rules were written for the same React app and keep matching by structure, but the signed-in feed could not be reached, so the Reels, Explore, Stories and posts rules were not re-checked on desktop. Messages stays visible on purpose (the fixtures mark it data-keep).

**2026-11-15 addition** (iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chrome driven over CDP, logged out, `/reels/` after scrolling to the next reel): `reel-app-wall` hides "Continue watching in the app" (Sign up for Instagram, Open app), a full-reel overlay that is not a dialog: a `div[role=group]` (absolute, the size of the reel) holding a 0.7 black backdrop and the card, which has `a[href="/accounts/signup/phone"]`. `LIVE` 1 when it appeared (it shows on some reel loads only). Hiding the group takes the backdrop with it.
